Before substantive repository assistance, verify that this repository is
registered in Agent-Operations and has the current complete bootstrap. If not,
stop, identify the missing conditions, and ask the owner to authorize
onboarding.

Read `.agent-operations.json`, then follow the private
`BoDa7s/Agent-Operations` contract from its configured local clone or GitHub,
the project policy, and `docs/PROJECT-OPERATIONS.md`. If the shared contract is
unavailable, say that onboarding cannot be verified and stop substantive
repository work. Do not introduce credentials, publication, or deployment

Before managed-project work, read the shared `SESSION-LEDGER.md`, query matching

Checkpoint progress, failures, external changes, owner waits, and closeout so
other agent platforms can continue.
